candidates: When reviewing code that uses cell or atomic-force filter classes (e.g., `ExpCellFilter`), verify imports come from `ase.filters` — the canonical location — rather than from `ase.constraints`, which only re-exports them for backward compatibility.

When reviewing code that uses the `FIRE` optimizer, check two API points that changed together: (1) the step-size parameter must be `maxstep`, not the deprecated `maxmove`; and (2) convergence should be determined from the boolean return value of `dyn.run()` rather than a separate `dyn.converged()` call, whose signature changed in the same release.

Tutorial scripts under `doc/tutorials/` are not automatically executed in CI; when reviewing any change to these files, manually run the affected scripts end-to-end to catch runtime errors (import failures, renamed parameters, API mismatches) that would otherwise go undetected until a user hits them.

Tutorial scripts that conditionally use an optional external package (e.g., toggled by a `use_asap = True/False` flag) must have a working default path that does not require the external package; verify that setting the flag to `False` (or equivalent) allows the script to run cleanly, and flag any merge request that leaves the optional-package path as the only exercised one.
